scope: Whole-manuscript neuroscience interpretation and original stimulus-guide figure; no new training or numerical result changes.
framing: Both sizes remain complementary production conditions; primary, secondary and exploratory analyses remain distinguished.
Learned filter organization, local contextual integration and decoded response sign are distinct measurements.
Unchanged distant local responses constrain the tested architecture; they do not establish that surface appearance requires a uniformly filled early cortical map.
Recurrent integration, multiscale feedforward processing and a shared spatial appearance decoder are prospective tests, not implemented explanations.
